mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness triggering risk-off behavior that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising labor force participation (PAYEMS > 135,000) and subdued inflation (CPIAUCSL < 230) indicate sustainable economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 AND CPIAUCSL < 230.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, elevated housing starts (HOUST > 900) signal robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Higher inflation levels (CPIAUCSL) correlate with increased real interest rates, reducing equity valuation multiples and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates manufacturing weakness, triggering equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13,700) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.1) signals sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13700 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity risk premiums, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycle regime, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances.
